name: Loan Contract 4
definition: Contract by which an amount of money in exchange for future repayment of the principal amount along with interest or other finance charges.

ContractDocumentIdentification.name: Contract Document Identification
ContractDocumentIdentification.definition: Contract document referenced from this loan agreement.

LoanTypeIdentification.name: Loan Type Identification
LoanTypeIdentification.definition: Type code of the loan contract.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Party that is specified as the buyer for this loan agreement.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Party that is specified as the seller for this loan agreement.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Loan amount as defined in the contract.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Planned final repayment date at the time of issuance.

ProlongationFlag.name: Prolongation Flag
ProlongationFlag.definition: Indicates whether the contract duration is extended or not.|When absent, the flag meaning is NotApplicable.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Start date of the loan contract.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Currency in which the loan is being settled.

SpecialConditions.name: Special Conditions
SpecialConditions.definition: Special conditions applicable when the amount is credited outside of the country.

DurationCode.name: Duration Code
DurationCode.definition: Loan duration in a coded form.

Tranche.name: Tranche
Tranche.definition: One part or division of the loan, used to define the repayment.

PaymentSchedule.name: Payment Schedule
PaymentSchedule.definition: Schedule of the payments defined for the loan contract.

InterestSchedule.name: Interest Schedule
InterestSchedule.definition: Schedule of the interest payments defined for the loan contract.

IntraCompanyLoan.name: Intra Company Loan
IntraCompanyLoan.definition: Loan is an intra company loan.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Details of the collateral for the loan.

SyndicatedLoan.name: Syndicated Loan
SyndicatedLoan.definition: Loan offered by a group of lenders (called a syndicate) who work together to provide funds for a single borrower.

Attachment.name: Attachment
Attachment.definition: Documents provided as attachments to the loan contract.
